title: Galen of Pergamon: Botany and Medicine
reason: This transcript describes the influence of Galen on botany and agriculture, detailing his impact on plant cultivation and medicinal use.

tasks.task: Describe Galen's impact on botany and agriculture.

subtasks.text: Note that Galen was one of the most influential physicians of the ancient world.

subtasks.text: Highlight that his contributions extended beyond medicine to include botany and agriculture.
